es: Escribir un mensaje a un equipo con dos o tres modismos apropiados, sin mezclar metáforas y con una alternativa sencilla.

teaching.en: Use idioms sparingly: one per paragraph is appropriate for a colleague, but a client from abroad may prefer plain language.
teaching.es: Usa los modismos con moderación: uno por párrafo es apropiado para un colega, pero un cliente extranjero puede preferir un lenguaje sencillo.
teaching.explanationEs: Sparingly y appropriate: pocos modismos y adecuados al lector; plain es la alternativa clara.
segments: Use idioms sparingly: one per paragraph is appropriate for a
colleague, but a client from abroad may prefer plain language.
teaching.audioText: Use idioms sparingly: one per paragraph is appropriate for a colleague, but a client from abroad may prefer plain language.

teaching.en: We need to hit the ground running on Monday; in plain words, every person must know their task before the first morning.
teaching.es: Tenemos que empezar con fuerza el lunes; dicho con palabras sencillas, cada persona debe conocer su tarea antes de la primera mañana.
teaching.explanationEs: Hit the ground running: empezar rápido y con energía desde el primer día. In plain words introduce la versión sencilla.
segments: We need to hit the ground running on Monday; in plain
words, every person must know their task before the first morning.
teaching.audioText: We need to hit the ground running on Monday; in plain words, every person must know their task before the first morning.

teaching.en: Let's touch base on Friday to share our progress; it is an appropriate idiom for a colleague, but for a client I would write a brief call.
teaching.es: Hablemos brevemente el viernes para compartir el avance; es un modismo apropiado para un colega, pero para un cliente escribiría una breve llamada.
teaching.explanationEs: Touch base: contacto breve para ponerse al día; se dice sin artículo.
segments: Let's touch base on Friday to share our progress; it is an appropriate idiom
for a colleague, but for a client I would write a brief call.
teaching.audioText: Let's touch base on Friday to share our progress; it is an appropriate idiom for a colleague, but for a client I would write a brief call.

teaching.en: Some writers say burn that bridge when we come to it, but that is a mixed metaphor: the real idiom is cross that bridge when we come to it.
teaching.es: Algunos escriben quemaremos ese puente cuando lleguemos a él, pero es una metáfora mezclada: el modismo real es cruzaremos ese puente cuando lleguemos.
teaching.explanationEs: Mixed metaphor: mezclar dos modismos (burn a bridge + cross that bridge) confunde; usa uno completo.
segments: Some writers say burn that bridge when we come to it, but that is a
mixed metaphor: the real idiom is cross that bridge when we come to it.
teaching.audioText: Some writers say burn that bridge when we come to it, but that is a mixed metaphor: the real idiom is cross that bridge when we come to it.

teaching.en: Many of us burned the midnight oil last week; in other words, we worked very late to finish the report before the deadline.
teaching.es: Muchos de nosotros trabajamos hasta muy tarde la semana pasada; dicho de otro modo, trabajamos muy tarde para terminar el informe antes del plazo.
teaching.explanationEs: In other words da la alternativa sencilla junto al modismo; burn the midnight oil = trabajar de noche.

teaching.en: The delay is only the tip of the iceberg; as an alternative for foreign readers, add in plain words that there are more problems.
teaching.es: El retraso es solo la punta del iceberg; como alternativa para lectores extranjeros, añade con palabras sencillas que hay más problemas.
teaching.explanationEs: Tip of the iceberg: solo una parte visible de un problema mayor. La alternative sencilla ayuda al lector extranjero.

prompt.es: Detecta el problema del modismo del mensaje.

choices.text: It uses too many idioms for such a short note.
It mixes two idioms into one confusing image.
It uses an idiom that is too formal for a team.

feedback.es: Burn a bridge y cross that bridge son dos modismos distintos: mezclados forman una imagen confusa.

hint.es: Piensa en los dos modismos con bridge que conoces.

origin.text: A manager sends this note to her team: “The budget is uncertain, so let's burn that bridge when we come to it, and meanwhile keep working.” One colleague says it sounds odd.

prompt.es: Completa: «Hagamos un breve punto de contacto el viernes para revisar el avance.»

feedback.es: Touch base es la expresión fija para un contacto breve; no lleva artículo y el verbo es touch.

hint.es: Es el verbo que se usa con base en este modismo.

origin.text: We are all busy this week, so a long meeting is impossible. Let's ___ base on Friday, just ten minutes to check our progress.

prompt.es: Ordena: «En palabras sencillas, necesitamos más tiempo.»

answer.text: In plain words, we need more time

feedback.es: In plain words abre la versión sencilla; después va la idea en una frase corta.

prompt.es: Elige el mensaje con un modismo apropiado y una alternativa clara.

choices.text: We must hit the ground running, touch base every day and cross that bridge next week.
We must hit the ground running, and I hope that everybody understands what I mean.
We must hit the ground running; in other words, we start fast and on time.

feedback.es: Usa un solo modismo y lo explica de inmediato con in other words; las otras opciones acumulan modismos o no dan alternativa.

origin.text: You are writing to a team that includes colleagues from abroad. You want to use one idiom, and you want everybody to understand it on the first reading.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada modismo con su alternativa sencilla.

pairs.es: solo una pequeña parte de un problema mayor

feedback.es: Cada modismo tiene una versión clara y literal que puedes usar para un lector extranjero.

pairs.es: solo una pequeña parte de un problema mayor

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de voz y elige la versión sencilla.

choices.text: Work starts at eight and everyone must be ready.
Work starts at nine with a slow first morning.
Nobody needs to come in on Monday at all.

feedback.es: «In other words» explica el modismo: el trabajo empieza a las ocho y todos deben llegar preparados.

origin.audio: Hi team. I know many of you are new, so let me be careful with my words. We will hit the ground running on Monday. In other words, we start work at eight, and everybody needs to be ready with their task and their tools. On Friday we will touch base. In plain words, we meet for ten minutes to share our progress. I will keep my messages simple this week, and please tell me whenever something is not clear. See you there.

prompt.es: Elige la versión moderada del borrador con una alternativa clara.

choices.text: We must hit the ground running, burn the midnight oil, touch base and cross that bridge.
We must hit the ground running on Monday; in plain words, we start fast.
We must hit the ground running, burn the midnight oil and touch the base on Friday.

feedback.es: Deja un solo modismo y añade la versión sencilla; las otras acumulan modismos o cambian una expresión fija.

origin.text: Sara's draft for the team: “This week we must burn the midnight oil, touch base daily, hit the ground running on Monday and cross that bridge when we come to it.” Tom says it is too much: it has four idioms in one sentence.

prompt.es: Completa: «Dicho de otro modo, el informe llegó tarde.»

feedback.es: In other words introduce una reformulación sencilla; in plain words también sirve como alternativa.

origin.text: Our report was handed in three days late, and the client was not pleased. Since some readers may not know the idiom, I added a clear version: in ___ words, the report was late.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué quiere decir la oradora con «the tip of the iceberg».

choices.text: The delay is small and does not matter, so the full report can wait until later.
The printer problem is the only serious one, and volunteers will fix it.
There are more problems than the delay, so the team must read the report.

feedback.es: La imprenta cerrada y los dos voluntarios que se van son más problemas: el retraso es solo la parte visible, y por eso pide leer el informe.

origin.audio: Hello everyone. I need to apologise for the delay with the poster designs. I am afraid this is just the tip of the iceberg: the printer has also closed for the holidays, and two volunteers have dropped out. Please read the full report before Monday, because I would like us to decide together what to do.

prompt.es: Escribe al equipo (unas 150 palabras): tres modismos y una alternativa sencilla.

answer.text: Hi team, the book fair starts on Monday, so we need to hit the ground running. In other words, we start work early and every person needs to know their task. Let's touch base on Friday for a short meeting to check our progress. I must also be honest: the delay with the posters is only the tip of the iceberg, because we still need more volunteers. In plain words, we have more problems than we thought, so please tell me if you can help. I do not want to use many idioms, so I will keep the rest simple. The plan is clear: posters on Tuesday, volunteers by Wednesday, and a last meeting on Friday. If any of you is not sure about a task, write to me tonight, and I will explain it in simple words. We are a small team, but I am sure that, working together, we can make this book fair a real success. Thank you for your work, and see you on Monday at eight!

In plain words, we have more problems than we thought, so please tell me if you can help. I do not want to use many idioms, so I will keep the rest simple. The plan is clear: posters on Tuesday, volunteers by Wednesday, and a last meeting on Friday. If any of you is not sure about a task, write to me tonight, and I will explain it in simple words. We are a small team, but I am sure that, working together, we can make this book fair a real success. Thank you for your work, and see you on Monday at eight!

Hello everyone, our book fair begins on Monday, so we have to hit the ground running. In other words, we start quickly and we all know our tasks. Let's touch base on Friday for a brief meeting. The delay with the posters is the tip of the iceberg, because we also need more volunteers. In plain words, there are more problems than we expected, so please tell me how you can help. I do not want to use many idioms, so I will keep the rest simple. The plan is clear: posters on Tuesday, volunteers by Wednesday, and a final meeting on Friday. Every person should know their task before Monday morning, and if something is not clear, please write to me tonight and I will explain it in simple words. We are a small team, but together we can make this fair a great success. Thanks a lot for your help!

feedback.es: El mensaje debe usar modismos sin mezclarlos, añadir una versión sencilla y cubrir los datos: lunes, reunión del viernes, voluntarios y carteles.

origin.text: Datos: feria del libro escolar. Empieza el lunes. Hay una reunión breve el viernes. Faltan voluntarios y hay retraso en los carteles. Escribe a tu equipo, que incluye colegas extranjeros. Usa tres modismos apropiados sin mezclarlos y una alternativa sencilla con «in other words».

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué la directora reformula con «in other words».

choices.text: To make sure visitors who do not know idioms follow the request.
To practise idioms with the visitors before the open day is over.
To ask her colleagues to write the message again in other languages.

feedback.es: Dice que muchos visitantes vienen del extranjero y, tras la frase general, da la petición concreta: lo hace para asegurarse de que todos la entienden.

origin.audio: At the school open day, the head teacher began with a joke: I love idioms, but many of our visitors are from abroad today, so I will say it simply. We need your help, she said. In other words, please come on Saturday at ten, bring a friend, and help us to tidy the playground. Then she smiled and asked whether everybody was on the same page.

prompt.es: Completa: «Ya veremos eso cuando llegue el momento.»

feedback.es: Cross that bridge when we come to it es el modismo completo: no se mezcla con burn a bridge.

origin.text: Some of you ask what we will do if it rains on Saturday. We have no plan yet, and it is too early to worry: we will ___ that bridge when we come to it.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Usa modismos con medida y ten lista una alternativa sencilla.»

answer.text: Use idioms sparingly and keep a plain alternative

feedback.es: Sparingly modifica al verbo use, y keep a plain alternative añade la versión clara como segunda acción.
